scope: One inert research attempt with no bounty, bond, payout, slash, or refund.

assumptions.statement: The research profile has no monetary settlement effects.
assumptions.falsifier: Any payout, slash, refund, bounty, bond, or reputation mutation is reachable.

preconditions: The attempt can consume model calls.
sequence: Loop without producing an accepted terminal.
scenarios.informationAdvantage: The worker observes its own progress and call cadence before the operator does.
scenarios.falsifier: A trace exceeds the exact call, time, or attempt cap or can create an untracked child.
scenarios.reevaluationTrigger: Any live provider integration or changed attempt ceiling.

defenses.statement: One attempt uses explicit native-unit ceilings and fails closed at the boundary.
assumptions: The effect boundary completely mediates model calls.
defenses.falsifier: An effect reaches the provider without crossing the counted boundary.

unresolved: Provider allowance remaining and burn rate are not directly observable.
